What this means
In this part you learn to identify Christmas as a Christian .(Luke 2:1-7) 2.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify Christmas as a Christian .(Luke 2:1-7) 2..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify Christmas as a Christian .(Luke 2:1-7) 2..
3. Practise this skill: role play a Christmas event observe the displayed pictures 3. When was Jesus.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. When is your RELIGIOUS Christmas learner should be able to: story of the birth of Jesus Christ. birthday?
2. When was Jesus c) sing Christmas carols and on events that take place during Christ born?

2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
